name: Legrand Wolf
summary: Legrand Wolf is an American adult film gay performer, producer, director, and entrepreneur, best known as the founder and CEO of Carnal Media, an adult entertainment company, and home of CarnalPlus. He has won four GayVN Awards and thirteen Grabby Awards for his work.
